Moss, lichen and small shrubs grow on the plain, and slender trees grow in the bottom of the ravine(which is more fertile due to pooling water and rotting trapped animals. Something (grazing animals, drifting blades, inter-plant warfare...) keeps the top of the trees not growing higher than the shrubs.
